feature_definitions.Size: Original SLOW -log(raw Close*latest positive PIT disclosed shares), exact 1/99 winsor/median/zero/sample-z normalization; z_size.
feature_definitions.Illiquidity: Original SLOW abs(organizer raw_return)/positive raw TurnoverValue, trailing 60 exchange sessions, min40, same normalization; z_amihud.
feature_definitions.SLOW_CONTROL: Exact original size_liquidity = daily zscore(mean(z_size,z_amihud)), no smoothing.
feature_definitions.MOM60: Frozen res60s1: raw_return-beta*same-date topix, within-original relisting segment shift1, rolling60/min60 sum, same-date centered average rank, EWMA(.25,adjust=False).
feature_definitions.rank: p=same-date average-tie percentile rank; 2*(p-mean(p)). The factor2 is the existing centered-rank convention and has no effect on official ordering. All-tie/singleton=0.
feature_definitions.SLOW_MOM60_EQUAL: (SizeRank+IlliquidityRank+MOM60Rank)/3. Exactly three independent equally weighted final component ranks. No extra smoothing. Different from .5*SLOW_CONTROL+.5*MOM60.

model: One fixed label-free equal-factor rank combination; no fitted coefficients or selection
selection_rule: All requested gates conjunctive vs SLOW. Annual net/Long/Short/MDD/turnover/incremental gross-cost gates checked on both POOLED and EX2016, conservatively fixed before trial. Net Sharpe improvement in >=4/5 full years; 2016 partial excluded. Primary pooled bootstrap lower>0; EX2016 secondary descriptive bootstrap also saved. Stop after one candidate, no rescue.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block across eligible sessions, percentile CI, ddof1 Sharpe

orthogonality.score: daily cross-sectional Spearman, daily-unweighted pooled/year means and matrices; stacked stock-day Spearman/Pearson separately labeled
orthogonality.pl: gross/net Pearson, mean daily Long/Short Jaccard; compounded net drawdown depth Pearson with initial1 and per-scope reset

attribution.membership: official positive weights=HIGH (Q4/Q5), negative=LOW (Q1/Q2); residual OTHER. Current membership assigns all costs, including neutral exit costs.
attribution.measures: stock-days, finite targets, forward target mean, candidate/SLOW gross/net/cost/turnover and deltas; daily and all scopes; stock-day sum and annual contributions; no filter

audit: Exact index/dtype/bit values, each source plus all future mutations, truncation, row shuffle, deterministic rebuild, label independence, maturity/purge, official accounting, explicit Train-only stage/firewall, frozen MOM residual source and old audit comparison.
